verdict.rationale: RudderStack is a customer-data SaaS with AI features (an AI agent in Slack and an MCP server), so a policy or control preventing customer data from being used for AI model training is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out or no-training commitment. Adjacent controls such as PII blocking and masking, consent management, and storing data on your own infrastructure are related but different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
